collections.name: support_teams
collections.description: Reference collection for internal teams that tickets can be routed to and that are used in average resolution time reporting.

embedding_vs_references.reason: Support teams are a small shared dimension reused across many tickets and dashboard metrics. Referencing avoids repeated updates if team names change while keeping ticket records stable.

indexes.name: ux_team_code
indexes.reason: Lookup and validation of routing targets by stable team code for triage suggestions and dashboard joins.

indexes.name: ix_active_name
indexes.reason: Support internal UI/API listing of active teams for filters or validation.

collections.name: tickets
collections.description: Core collection holding imported representative historical ticket data and POV ticket workflow state, including source text, actual outcomes, and optional system-generated triage guidance.

fields.name: triage_suggestion
fields.reason: Stores POV-generated guidance for agent review. Optional because imported historical records may predate suggestion generation and routing behavior is still clarification-sensitive.

fields.name: similar_ticket_cache
fields.reason: Optional inline cache of top 3-4 similar resolved tickets for the ticket-open workflow to support instant retrieval in the POV.

fields.name: embedding
fields.reason: Vector representation of combined ticket text for semantic similar-ticket retrieval and possibly text-based triage pipelines.

relationships.reason: Links a ticket to 3-4 semantically similar resolved historical tickets shown when an agent opens the ticket.

embedding_vs_references.reason: Ticket-specific artifacts that are read together in the agent workflow (triage_suggestion and optional similar_ticket_cache) are embedded to avoid extra lookups. Shared team data is referenced because many tickets point to the same team and dashboard metrics group by team.

indexes.name: ux_ticket_number
indexes.reason: Stable lookup of an individual ticket for the agent ticket-open workflow.

indexes.name: ix_status_created_at
indexes.reason: Support fetching recently opened or in-progress tickets for internal POV workflows and time-window dashboard queries.

indexes.name: ix_product_line_created_at
indexes.reason: Supports dashboard aggregations of ticket volume by product line over time.

indexes.name: ix_manual_priority_created_at
indexes.reason: Supports dashboard aggregations of ticket volume by priority over time using existing manually assigned priority data.

indexes.name: ix_assigned_team_resolved_at
indexes.reason: Supports average resolution time by team over time by grouping resolved tickets by assigned team.

indexes.name: ix_resolution_category
indexes.reason: Supports filtering or faceting similar resolved tickets and analysis by existing historical resolution category.

indexes.name: ix_resolved_filter
indexes.reason: Efficiently isolates resolved historical tickets for similarity recommendations and dashboard calculations involving completed work.

indexes.name: ticket_text_search
indexes.reason: Supports keyword/text retrieval and hybrid search over ticket text and resolution text when exploring historical tickets or backing off from vector similarity.

indexes.name: ticket_embedding_vector
indexes.reason: Supports low-latency semantic retrieval of 3-4 similar resolved historical tickets when an agent opens a ticket, matching the requirement for instant similar-case suggestions from unstructured text at growing scale.

collections.name: dashboard_metric_snapshots
collections.description: Pre-aggregated metric snapshots for near-real-time dashboard display of ticket volume and average resolution time without recomputing all historical aggregations on each request.

embedding_vs_references.strategy: reference for team_id, no embedding otherwise
embedding_vs_references.reason: Dashboard snapshots are aggregation outputs. They reference team when needed and otherwise store scalar dimensions directly for fast reads.

indexes.name: ux_metric_bucket_dims
indexes.reason: Supports idempotent upsert of metric snapshots and efficient dashboard reads by metric and time bucket.

indexes.name: ix_metric_type_bucket_start
indexes.reason: Supports time-series style retrieval for chart rendering over selected periods.
